organization.name: Apex Financial Technologies S.A.
organization.audit_scope: Enterprise Hybrid AWS Cloud & Corporate Infrastructure

ranked_risks.title: Credential & Identity Lifecycle Management
ranked_risks.evidence: Google Workspace / Okta in place, but legacy administrator accounts exist in AWS without MFA enforcement.
ranked_risks.gap: CRITICAL: Multiple privileged IAM users have non-expiring access keys and SMS MFA vulnerable to SIM-swapping.
ranked_risks.remediation: Enforce FIDO2 / WebAuthn hardware security keys for all privileged access; automate IAM key rotation every 90 days.

ranked_risks.title: Incident Response Plan & Execution
ranked_risks.evidence: A generic Incident Response PDF exists from 2023. No tabletop exercises conducted; no SLA defined for regulatory disclosure.
ranked_risks.gap: High risk of non-compliance with EU DORA strict 4-hour major incident notification requirements.
ranked_risks.remediation: Revise IRP with DORA-compliant escalation matrix; conduct bi-annual executive ransomware tabletop simulation.

ranked_risks.title: Third-Party Supplier Due Diligence
ranked_risks.evidence: Procurement conducts ad-hoc security questionnaires. No continuous monitoring of SaaS vendor posture.
ranked_risks.gap: High risk of third-party breach via critical cloud providers without SOC 2 Type II validation.
ranked_risks.remediation: Implement an automated Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) platform and mandate SOC 2 / ISO 27001 for Tier 1 vendors.

ranked_risks.title: Vulnerability Identification & Threat Modeling
ranked_risks.evidence: Quarterly external penetration testing performed; internal vulnerability scanning is irregular.
ranked_risks.gap: Zero automated container image scanning in CI/CD pipeline leading to vulnerable third-party packages in production.
ranked_risks.remediation: Integrate automated DevSecOps container security scanner (Trivy/Snyk) into GitLab CI pipeline with build-blocking policy.

ranked_risks.title: Network & Cloud Telemetry Monitoring
ranked_risks.evidence: AWS CloudWatch and GuardDuty enabled. Centralized SIEM lacks endpoint detection telemetry.
ranked_risks.gap: No EDR deployed on 40% of macOS/Linux engineer workstations; blind spots in lateral movement detection.
ranked_risks.remediation: Deploy enterprise EDR (CrowdStrike/Wazuh) across 100% of workstations and integrate into 24/7 MDR SOC.

ranked_risks.title: Restoration of Core Banking Services
ranked_risks.evidence: Daily automated AWS snapshots taken and replicated to secondary EU region.
ranked_risks.gap: Backups have not undergone a clean bare-metal restoration drill in the past 12 months; RTO/RPO untested.
ranked_risks.remediation: Implement immutable AWS S3 Object Lock for air-gapped ransomware backups and conduct full disaster recovery failover drill.

ranked_risks.title: Hardware & Virtual Infrastructure Inventory
ranked_risks.evidence: AWS resources tracked via Terraform, but on-prem endpoints and branch office devices rely on manual spreadsheets.
ranked_risks.gap: Shadow IT and unmanaged laptops connecting via remote VPN without continuous endpoint discovery.
ranked_risks.remediation: Deploy automated Cyber Asset Attack Surface Management (CAASM) agent syncing all assets into CMDB.

ranked_risks.title: Data-at-Rest & In-Transit Protection
ranked_risks.evidence: TLS 1.3 enforced on public APIs; RDS database encrypted with AWS KMS.
ranked_risks.gap: Lack of Data Loss Prevention (DLP) controls on employee workstations and customer support ticketing exports.
ranked_risks.remediation: Deploy endpoint DLP to block unencrypted cardholder data exports; implement automated PII tokenization.

ranked_risks.title: Organizational Mission & Regulatory Stakeholders
ranked_risks.evidence: Business strategy defines growth targets, but cybersecurity risk appetite is not formalized in board charter.
ranked_risks.gap: Lack of quantified risk appetite metrics (e.g. Value-at-Risk) reviewed by Board of Directors.
ranked_risks.remediation: Establish a Board-level Cybersecurity Committee with quarterly review of quantified risk tolerance.
